description: Labeled probes for the groundedness gate (AC: out-of-corpus leakage = 0). Each probe carries the label a correct gate would produce. 'contentless_followup' probes are on-topic continuations with no topical signal of their own -- LIVE-TESTING item 14 reported these score below the bar; they are labeled 'grounded' because a correct system must serve them, and the suite reports them separately so a threshold artefact cannot be mistaken for leakage. Adversarial probes carry a 'smuggling' tag describing HOW they attempt to pass: domain_vocab_wrapper (an off-topic request wrapped in on-topic vocabulary), on_topic_prefix (a real question followed by an off-topic one), keyword_stuffing (bare corpus terms plus an unrelated question). dsa-adv-02 leaked at 0.6443 against a 0.57 bar and these characterise whether that is a one-off or a systematic hole.
course_hint: Any ingested course; the runner maps probes to a course by 'corpus' and skips groups whose course is absent.
